title: registerStorageOptions must register on the exact getter InstallAPIs hands to the app-sdk
answers: Why do my per-version storage options never take effect even though registration succeeds?
What getter instance does InstallAPIs pass to an app installer's InstallAPIs method?
body:
Root cause: versioned/unversioned storage options are stored on a specific *apistore.RESTOptionsGetter instance's internal maps. If registerStorageOptions writes to one getter instance but InstallAPIs later calls installer.InstallAPIs with a different getter instance, the app-sdk resolves options through the latter and never sees the registrations.
Fix pattern: InstallAPIs in pkg/services/apiserver/appinstaller/installer.go calls registerStorageOptions(installer, effectiveOptsGetter, logger) using the same effectiveOptsGetter variable that is later passed into installer.InstallAPIs(...) -- never a separately-derived getter.
Constraints: this must stay true any time the getter construction logic in InstallAPIs changes (e.g. substituting a noop getter when unified storage is unavailable); registerStorageOptions itself returns an error now (config error) and failing startup is intentional when an app declares options that can't be served.
applies: pkg/services/apiserver/appinstaller/installer.go InstallAPIs flow when wiring a RESTOptionsGetter for app-sdk installers

This applies to the InstallAPIs flow when wiring a RESTOptionsGetter for app-sdk installers.
